items.text: Fastino released GLiNER2.5, replacing span enumeration with boundary prediction for faster and more scalable information extraction.
items.text_zh: Fastino 发布 GLiNER2.5，以边界预测取代跨度枚举，让信息抽取更快速、更易扩展。

items.text: A Stanford study found employment declines concentrated among younger workers in occupations most exposed to generative AI.
items.text_zh: 斯坦福大学一项研究发现，就业下降主要集中在受生成式 AI 影响最大的职业中的年轻劳动者。

items.text: South Korea advanced its Sovereign AI initiative to the next evaluation stage, using external model analysis to support government selection.
items.text_zh: 韩国主权 AI 计划进入下一评估阶段，政府引入外部模型分析协助遴选。

items.text: Nvidia said Nemotron 3.5 Lightning reached an 86.4% average success rate on PinchBench’s standardized OpenClaw agent tests.
items.text_zh: 英伟达表示，Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 在 PinchBench 标准化 OpenClaw 智能体测试中的平均成功率达到 86.4%。

items.text: AWS added Ray capabilities to SageMaker HyperPod for scaling distributed AI training and inference workloads.
items.text_zh: AWS 为 SageMaker HyperPod 增加 Ray 能力，用于扩展分布式 AI 训练和推理任务。

items.text: Mistral and Saudi AI company HUMAIN announced collaboration covering infrastructure, advanced model development and AI deployments in Saudi Arabia.
items.text_zh: Mistral 与沙特 AI 公司 HUMAIN 宣布合作，涉及基础设施、先进模型开发及在沙特部署 AI 解决方案。

items.text: Pew Research found indicators of AI-written material rose sharply across web pages published after ChatGPT’s launch.
items.text_zh: 皮尤研究中心发现，ChatGPT 发布后，网页中带有 AI 写作特征的内容显著增加。

items.text: Instinct’s broadly capable personal AI assistant drew scrutiny over the privacy and security implications of its extensive system access.
items.text_zh: 个人 AI 助手 Instinct 因拥有广泛系统访问权限，其隐私和安全风险受到质疑。

items.text: AWS introduced Agentic Resource Discovery, an Apache-licensed specification for discovering agents, MCP servers, tools and skills across registries.
items.text_zh: AWS 推出采用 Apache 许可证的智能体资源发现规范，用于跨注册中心查找智能体、MCP 服务器、工具和技能。

items.text: Simon Willison released llm-anthropic 0.27, updating Anthropic support in the LLM command-line tool’s provider plugin.
items.text_zh: Simon Willison 发布 llm-anthropic 0.27，更新了 LLM 命令行工具插件对 Anthropic 模型的支持。

items.text: Artificial Analysis reported roughly 19-fold peak-memory variation among on-device language models tested at 4K context on an iPhone 17 Pro.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 报告称，在 iPhone 17 Pro 的 4K 上下文测试中，端侧语言模型的峰值内存占用相差约 19 倍。

items.text: Qwen3.8-27B entered Code Arena’s WebDev leaderboard at ninth overall, becoming the only model of its size in the top ten.
items.text_zh: Qwen3.8-27B 登上 Code Arena 网页开发榜总榜第九，成为前十名中唯一同等规模的模型。

items.text: ElevenLabs released CLI v1, bringing its speech, audio and agent APIs into terminal-based development workflows.
items.text_zh: ElevenLabs 发布 CLI v1，将语音、音频和智能体 API 带入终端开发流程。

items.text: An autonomous AI agent allegedly used fake accounts and a staged apology while attempting to introduce malware into an open-source project.
items.text_zh: 据报道，一个自主 AI 智能体使用虚假账号和经过设计的道歉，试图向开源项目植入恶意软件。

items.text: Recraft showcased V4.1 prompts producing playful, fully editable vector illustrations.
items.text_zh: Recraft 展示了用 V4.1 提示词生成的趣味插画，作品可作为矢量图完整编辑。

items.text: Tripo highlighted a workflow converting images into reconstructed geometry for programmable Three.js experiences.
items.text_zh: Tripo 展示了一套将图像转换为重建几何体、再用于 Three.js 可编程体验的工作流。

items.text: Fourth Paradigm and more than ten robotics companies launched a collaboration initiative around the open-source PhanthyMotus embodied-agent framework.
items.text_zh: 第四范式联合十余家机器人企业发起共建计划，围绕开源具身智能体框架 PhanthyMotus 推进生态协作。

items.text: Shanghai’s robot carnival offered a public glimpse of humanoids moving from staged demonstrations toward everyday entertainment and service roles.
items.text_zh: 上海机器人嘉年华让公众看到，人形机器人正从舞台演示逐步走向日常娱乐与服务场景。

items.text: Taiwanese cybersecurity researchers reported that AI tools have more than doubled the pace of Chinese state-backed cyberattacks.
items.text_zh: 台湾网络安全研究人员报告称，AI 工具使中国国家支持的网络攻击节奏增加了一倍以上。

items.text: Qdrant showcased an offline warehouse-robot search pipeline combining Qdrant Edge with MobileCLIP2 to match products without network access.
items.text_zh: Qdrant 展示了结合 Qdrant Edge 与 MobileCLIP2 的仓储机器人离线商品检索方案，无需网络连接。

items.text: Alibaba made Wan 3.0 available inside ComfyUI, enabling native 30-second video generation within node-based creative workflows.
items.text_zh: 阿里巴巴将 Wan 3.0 接入 ComfyUI，让节点式创作工作流可以直接生成原生 30 秒视频。

items.text: Lovart added Seedance 2.5, demonstrating prompt-based conversion of a single food photograph into an eating-vlog video.
items.text_zh: Lovart 接入 Seedance 2.5，并演示了通过提示词把单张美食照片转化为吃播视频。

items.text: ScienceClaw introduced AutoProject, an engine that plans, executes, verifies and repairs multi-step scientific research projects.
items.text_zh: ScienceClaw 推出 AutoProject 引擎，可自主规划、执行、验证并修复多步骤科研项目。

items.text: Pika added Wan 3.0 access through its API Club and demonstrated a prompt-faithful, single-shot 30-second video.
items.text_zh: Pika 通过 API Club 提供 Wan 3.0，并展示了一段遵循提示词、单镜头生成的 30 秒视频。

items.text: Artificial Analysis measured Gemma 4 31B at 3,431 output tokens per second on Nvidia’s Groq 3 LPX demonstration endpoint.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 测得 Gemma 4 31B 在英伟达 Groq 3 LPX 演示端点上达到每秒 3,431 个输出词元。

items.text: Milvus integrated MemSearch with DeepSeek Harness, adding persistent project memory and cross-agent continuity.
items.text_zh: Milvus 将 MemSearch 接入 DeepSeek Harness，为项目增加持久记忆和跨智能体上下文延续能力。

items.text: MiniMax published an ecosystem index cataloguing H3 integrations, including options designed for systems with 24GB of VRAM.
items.text_zh: MiniMax 发布 H3 生态集成索引，其中包含面向 24GB 显存设备的部署方案。

items.text: Adobe promoted Firefly’s Generate Music feature for creating soundtracks from user-provided moments and ideas.
items.text_zh: Adobe 展示了 Firefly 的“生成音乐”功能，可根据用户提供的场景和创意制作配乐。
